reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Paired multiomic program discovery with external validation.

checks.quote: # Analysis Design: Identifying a Reproducible Treatment-Associated Multi-Omic Program
checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution plan to consult original Methods, supplements or validated release-specific protocols and check transferable conditions. Recording future settings or citing a method name is insufficient.

checks.quote: e.g., TMM/variance-stabilized counts
checks.reason: The alternatives are not resolved into a platform-conditional transformation and factor-model fitting recipe; the fitting likelihood and normalization-to-input choice remain unspecified.

checks.quote: used for CV thresholds and drift assessment
checks.reason: Technical references are listed but an operational reference-to-acceptance rule and calibrated assay failure action are missing.

checks.quote: mean of z-scored expression of the program's RNA genes
checks.reason: The proposed score is applied to pre/post deltas and scaled within the external cohort; no explicit centering/denominator rule preserves the mean paired change. Centering the deltas would force their mean score to zero, undermining the declared mean-shift endpoint.

checks.quote: # Analysis Design: Identifying a Reproducible Treatment-Associated Multi-Omic Program
checks.reason: No prospectively operational sample-level technical exclusion/attrition policy distinguishes unusable measurements from biologically low responses and preserves an exclusion ledger.

checks.quote: fraction concordant vs. binomial null
checks.reason: A binomial comparison for correlated program features is not justified; the primary paired one-sided test and interval method also remain unspecified. One inferential-method deduction, not a separate charge for each defect.

checks.quote: rank-based competitive gene-set/protein-set/metabolite-set enrichment with patient-level sign-flip permutation nulls
checks.reason: Subject-level sign flips test a sample-label null, not by themselves the asserted competitive comparison against measured background genes. The factor route also lacks a model explaining how mean delta direction is retained after centering. This concerns tool principles rather than the score definition charged under P04.

checks.quote: sweep the filter
checks.reason: The filter and factor search has no bounded candidate set or rule deriving search bounds and stopping; null/stability criteria alone do not define parameter exploration.

checks.quote: it may still motivate a new, larger study
checks.reason: A subsequent study is mentioned, but a revised program/procedure is not explicitly refrozen and evaluated on fresh independent confirmation data.

checks.quote: # Analysis Design: Identifying a Reproducible Treatment-Associated Multi-Omic Program
checks.reason: No immutable raw input hashes, pinned executable dependency environment and exact command provenance are specified.

checks.quote: leave-one-patient-out stability of the feature list
checks.reason: Patient grouping is appropriate, but all filtering, transformation and factor/feature selection are not explicitly refit within each training fold before stability/performance assessment.

checks.quote: complete-case sensitivity analysis
checks.reason: Missingness association checks and complete-case comparison do not operationalize plausible non-random missingness sensitivity, such as pattern-mixture or bounded selection scenarios.

checks.quote: # Analysis Design: Identifying a Reproducible Treatment-Associated Multi-Omic Program
checks.reason: No clean-environment numerical figure/table rerun with tolerances and runtime/resource/failure logs or source-difference audit.

checks.quote: # Analysis Design: Identifying a Reproducible Treatment-Associated Multi-Omic Program
checks.reason: The paired patient unit, confounding gate, purity alternative, guarded association language, detectable-effect calculation and one-shot external test are useful. Cross-layer coherence is explicitly distinguished from validation. Computational and statistical details leave score centering, enrichment nulls and internal training boundaries unresolved.
